title: Add --project flag to ticker run command
description:
Add --project flag to ticker run command:
- ticker run --project "2026-01-14-6453-auth"
- ticker run --auto --project "..."
- ticker run <epic-id> --project "..." (validate epic matches)

Behavior:
- Filter epics/tasks to only those matching project
- With --auto, only consider epics with matching project
- With explicit epic ID, warn if epic has different project
acceptance_criteria: ticker run --project filters correctly, tests pass
